black: Open BLACK and check your credits.
inspect: Read a node or satellite record.
open: Read an archive record or incident report.
analyze: Read a signal and its associated evidence.
trace: Follow the evidence linked to an event.
solve: Submit a decoded word in place of KEYWORD.
ask: Send a question to OMEGA in place of MESSAGE.
witness: Read the observer’s annotation after opening the sealed conclusion.
connect: Open an internal node session or the OMEGA interface.
isolate: Isolate a device in the registry.
restore: Restore a device and resolve its open incidents.
reject: Replace EVENT-ID with a pending link request ID.
review: Read an audit and receive its reward.
publish: Release the evidence to the public.
seal: Seal the evidence and collect the escrow.
